# Claude Code Skills: Bundled Skills

Bundled skills ship inside Claude Code, so you need no files to use them.
They are prompts that guide Claude through a common job.
For example, `/simplify` reviews changed code and fixes problems that it finds.
The marks are explained on [Skills and Commands](Claude-Code-Skills-And-Commands).

## Control

- Setting `disableBundledSkills` and env `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS` remove them.
  `/doctor` stays typable (`survivesBundledKillSwitch`).
- When policy `allow_bundled_skills` is not granted, only names in a fixed list stay.
  The bundle list is: `artifact-diagramming`, `batch`, `claude-code-docs`, `code-review`, `commit`, `dataviz`, `debug`, `explain-usage`, `fewer-permission-prompts`, `keybindings-help`, `loop`, `memory-types`, `plugin-authoring`, `pr`, `simplify`, `update-config`, `verify`, `workflow-authoring`.
- Source: bundle (the list of bundled skill names and the `allow_bundled_skills` key), [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills).
